claim: Google defines SRE as what happens when a software engineer designs an operations function — SREs are hired as software engineers who automate ops work.

claim: Google seeks UNIX system internals and networking (Layer 1 to Layer 3) expertise as the most common alternate technical skills for SREs who are not hired through the standard SWE process.

claim: NALSD design iterations explicitly probe failure modes up to full datacenter loss.
